players.product: Photosensitive materials for advanced photoresists (Photosensitive Materials segment); high-purity solvents for advanced logic and memory

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Gosei semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): photosensitive materials for advanced semiconductors and high-purity solvents were firm while general-purpose products and fragrance materials fell, so net sales rose to JPY 19,349 million (+JPY 605 million, +3.2%). Operating profit fell to JPY 937 million (-JPY 1,241 million, -57.0%), ordinary profit to JPY 831 million (-59.7%) and interim net income to JPY 570 million (-59.0%): depreciation rose JPY 929 million as the large facility for advanced-semiconductor photosensitive materials started operating, other fixed costs such as added headcount rose, and longer processes for leading-edge materials brought a lower-of-cost inventory valuation effect of about JPY 400 million. Photosensitive Materials: net sales JPY 11,760 million (+5.0%) - advanced photoresist materials up, general semiconductor materials slightly down, display materials steady - and an operating loss of JPY 305 million (-JPY 1,335 million YoY). Chemicals: net sales JPY 7,588 million (+0.6%), operating profit JPY 1,242 million (+8.2%), with high-purity solvents firm on data-center demand from the spread of generative AI and fragrance materials down on US tariff-related inventory adjustments and currency effects. Management states AI-related semiconductor devices kept driving the electronic materials market, while demand for smartphone and PC semiconductor materials had not yet fully recovered and automotive materials lacked strength.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 19,349 million (+3.2%); operating profit JPY 937 million (-57.0%); Photosensitive Materials operating loss JPY 305 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Gosei semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: New capacity status (semi-annual report): the large new production facility built to raise production capacity for photosensitive materials for advanced semiconductors was completed in October 2024 and has started operation and depreciation; product qualification and sample shipments to customers have begun, and management expects it to contribute to results as product qualification and stable mass production progress. H1 R&D expenses were JPY 859 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Facility completed October 2024; H1 R&D JPY 859 million
